backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the social media backend with Post/Comment/UserProfile data types, CRUD operations, like/view tracking, and access-controlled profile management using mixins for authorization and blob storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two ShortSportPage features (TikTok-style vertical snap scrolling and floating auto-scroll toggle button) to their implementing files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend components, pages, and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based light and dark mode CSS custom properties for the app's color tokens including background, foreground, primary, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that sets the page title to 'InstaV' and mounts the React app via the /src/main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app with ThemeProvider (dark default), InternetIdentityProvider, React Query's QueryClientProvider, and TanStack RouterProvider, plus a global Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AvatarPlaceholde: Reusable avatar component that renders an ExternalBlob profile picture if available, or falls back to gradient initials derived from the user's name and userId, supporting xs through xl sizes.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with five icon+label items (Home, Explore, ShortSport, Create, Profile) that highlights the active route and hides itself on the /shortsport full-screen page.
frontend/src/components/CommentsSheet.ts: Bottom-sheet comments panel for a given post that displays a paginated comment list with skeleton loading, and provides an authenticated text input form to submit new comments.
frontend/src/components/editor/AudioPane: Editor panel for managing audio tracks, allowing users to upload audio files or toggle a recording mode, with per-track volume and mute controls.
frontend/src/components/editor/DesignPan: Editor panel for configuring canvas aspect ratio, solid background colors, and gradient presets, updating the first clip's color in the editor state.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorCan: Canvas component that renders the current editor frame including background color, CSS filters, sticker layers, text layers, vignette, glitch, and letterbox effects.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorTim: Renders a video timeline with a ruler, playhead scrubbing, and a video track displaying clips as colored blocks with remove and add-blank-clip controls.
frontend/src/components/editor/EffectsPa: Displays a grid of toggleable motion graphics effects (e.g. confetti, glitch) and shows a summary of currently active effects.
frontend/src/components/editor/ExportPan: Provides a video preview, title/description metadata fields, and buttons to download the video or share a link.
frontend/src/components/editor/FiltersPa: Offers preset color grade filters and individual slider controls for brightness, contrast, saturation, and other image adjustments.
frontend/src/components/editor/StickersP: Lets users browse emoji stickers by category, add them as timed layers to the video, and edit or remove active sticker layers.
frontend/src/components/editor/TextPanel: Manages text overlay layers with controls for adding, selecting, editing font/style/animation properties, and removing text layers.
frontend/src/components/editor/Transitio: Renders a video editor transitions panel with a library of 10 transition types and controls to apply/toggle transitions between adjacent clips in the editor state.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: App shell layout component that composes TopBar, the routed page Outlet, and BottomNav within a centered max-width column with appropriate padding.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Renders a social media post card with author info, media (image/video), like/comment/view interactions, and optimistic like updates using intersection observer for view tracking.
frontend/src/components/TopBar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar displaying the app title, current page title, and a sign-in/sign-out button using Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Displays a video post card with thumbnail, play button overlay, duration badge, like/comment/bookmark actions, and a follow button using mock data types.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context and custom hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend data operations including user profiles, posts, comments, and mutations, built on top of the useActor hook.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that configures Tailwind CSS, imports Google Fonts, and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/src/lib/mockData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static mock data arrays for posts, comments, users, messages, and conversations used for UI development and testing.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility functions for class name merging (cn), number formatting, time formatting, and relative time display (timeAgo).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: A form page for creating new posts that supports file upload or URL input for photos, videos, and GIFs, with caption entry and media preview before submitting via the createPost mutation.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: A video/design editor page that defines shared editor types (clips, text layers, stickers, filters, etc.) and renders a multi-panel UI with tools for trimming, filters, effects, stickers, design, and export.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: An explore page with a debounced search bar and tabs for browsing/filtering all posts or searching users by handle, displaying results with navigation to profiles.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: The main feed page that fetches and lists all posts as PostCards, with loading/error/empty states and a slide-up CommentsSheet triggered by clicking a post's comment button.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: A messaging page that displays a list of mock conversations and an individual chat view with message bubbles, supporting sending new messages via an input field.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: A profile page handling Internet Identity login/logout, profile setup for new users, and editing of handle, display name, bio, and profile picture with file upload support.
frontend/src/pages/ShortSportPage.tsx: TikTok-style vertical reels page that filters video posts, uses IntersectionObserver for snap-scroll active tracking, supports mute toggle, optimistic likes, and a floating auto-scroll toggle button.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: Public user profile page that resolves a user by handle or principal, displays avatar, bio, and post grid, and supports opening a comments sheet on post selection.
frontend/src/routeTree.ts: Defines the TanStack Router route tree with a shared Layout (TopBar + BottomNav) and registers routes for feed, explore, editor, profile, shortsport, create, and user profile pages.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routing, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with oklch-based design tokens, custom border radii, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state manifest for InstaV tracking schema version, existing features (TikTok-style scrolling and auto-scroll toggle for ShortSportPage), and a pending feature request for the same ShortSport section.
